package com.github.dappermickie.runepouch.loadout.names;

import net.runelite.api.gameval.SpriteID;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class RunepouchLoadoutIcon {
  public int spriteId;
  public String name;

  public RunepouchLoadoutIcon(int spriteId, String name) {
    this.spriteId = spriteId;
    this.name = name;
  }

  public static List<RunepouchLoadoutIcon> getIcons(String search) {
    if (search.isEmpty()) {
      return ICONS;
    }

    return ICONS.stream()
      .filter(icon -> icon.name.toLowerCase().contains(search.toLowerCase()))
      .collect(Collectors.toList());
  }
